content: {"reasoning":"The required authorization was absent, the retro-authorization window is closed, the prior appeal did not resolve CO-197, and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review. Resubmission would not cure the authorization defect, and this contractual denial cannot properly be shifted to the patient despite the plan's standard coinsurance. The payer path is exhausted and no collectible patient or secondary balance remains.","action":"write_off"}
